```{=html}
<header class="c-pagehead">
  <div class="c-wrap">
<h1>Training programmes</h1>
    <p>
      Seven hands-on programmes, taught in sequence. They exist because a student
      cannot join a research project without them, and because nothing equivalent
      is freely available to most undergraduates here.
    </p>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--paper">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Curriculum</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">A route, not a catalogue</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        The programmes are ordered. Foundations first, then a language, then the
        assays. A student who completes the sequence can take on an independent
        analysis.
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- TODO(CHIRAL): add the next cohort dates and a registration link to each
         card. A course with no date attached reads as an archive rather than an
         offer, which is the single biggest thing this page is missing. -->

    <div class="c-grid-3">

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Foundations · No prerequisites</span>
        <h3>Linux for Bioinformatics</h3>
        <p>Command-line navigation, file management and text processing, applied to biological data and sequence analysis. Assumes no prior Linux experience.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/BioinformaticsBootCamp/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Language · No prerequisites</span>
        <h3>Python for Bioinformatics</h3>
        <p>Python from the start, then biological data manipulation, sequence analysis with Biopython, and automating an analysis you would otherwise repeat by hand.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/BioinformaticsBootCamp/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Language · No prerequisites</span>
        <h3>R for Bioinformatics</h3>
        <p>Data manipulation, statistics, visualisation and machine learning in R, with the Bioconductor packages the later courses depend on.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/RforBioinformatics/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Assay · Requires R</span>
        <h3>RNA-seq analysis with R</h3>
        <p>Preprocessing, quality control, differential expression, pathway enrichment and visualisation, worked on real datasets rather than toy ones.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/RNASeqwithR/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Assay · Requires RNA-seq</span>
        <h3>Single-cell RNA-seq with R</h3>
        <p>Quality control, dimensionality reduction, clustering and differential expression at single-cell resolution, including where the standard pipeline misleads.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/scRNASeqwithR/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Engineering · Requires Linux</span>
        <h3>Nextflow for Bioinformatics</h3>
        <p>Building, optimising and running reproducible workflows at scale — the step between running an analysis once and running it reliably.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/BioinformaticsBootCamp/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Intensive · All levels</span>
        <h3>Bioinformatics Bootcamp</h3>
        <p>The full sequence run as one intensive programme: sequence analysis, genomics, proteomics and data analysis across the standard toolchain.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="https://omicscenter.github.io/BioinformaticsBootCamp/">Programme site →</a>
      </article>

    </div>

    <div class="c-btn-row" style="margin-top:2.5rem">
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--dark" href="mailto:training.chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Application%20for%20a%20training%20programme">Apply to a programme</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--line" href="events.html">Upcoming dates</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--line" href="resources.html">Self-study resources</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--white">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-split">
      <div class="c-prose">
        <h2>How the programmes run</h2>
        <p>
          Sessions are hands-on and mostly online, so students outside Dhaka can
          take part. Every session ends with an exercise on real data, and the
          material stays available afterwards.
        </p>
        <p>
          Training is free. It is also not a certificate mill — we care whether a
          participant can go on to do the analysis unaided, and the programmes are
          assessed on that basis.
        </p>

        <h2>Who these are for</h2>
        <p>
          University students in life sciences, computer science, medicine, public
          health, statistics, geography and related fields. No programming
          background is assumed for the foundation courses.
        </p>

        <h2>Teaching materials</h2>
        <p>
          Course notebooks and slides are openly licensed and remain online after
          each cohort. See <a href="resources.html">learning resources</a> for the
          databases and tools we teach against, and
          <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hossainlab">recorded sessions</a> where
          available.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="c-aside">
        <dl class="c-facts">
          <dt>Cost</dt>
          <dd>Free. The centre charges nothing for training.</dd>

          <dt>Format</dt>
          <dd>Hands-on, primarily online, with materials retained after the cohort.</dd>

          <dt>Prerequisites</dt>
          <dd>None for foundation courses. Later courses assume the earlier ones.</dd>

          <dt>Next cohort</dt>
          <dd><span class="c-todo">To be announced</span></dd>

          <dt>Enquiries</dt>
          <dd><a href="mailto:training.chiralbd@gmail.com">training.chiralbd@gmail.com</a></dd>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
